subject: Geography
question_text_en: Which statement most accurately links plate boundary type with the expected landform and seismic pattern for UPSC map reasoning?
option_a: Convergent margins can form trenches, volcanic arcs, and shallow-to-deep earthquake zones.
option_b: Divergent margins form ocean trenches and only deep-focus earthquakes below continental crust.
option_c: Transform boundaries create fold mountains because plates collide head-on along the boundary.
option_d: Passive margins are the main global belts of volcanic arcs and frequent earthquakes.
explanation_en: Convergent boundaries are identified through trench and arc patterns, plus the Benioff earthquake zone; other options mix boundary signals.
